entries.averment: The complainant is a 'consumer' within s.2(7); goods/services were not obtained for a commercial purpose (self-employment for livelihood is not commercial).
Where a compensation figure is claimed, it has a stated basis (not a bare figure).
The complaint is supported by an affidavit.

source.ref: CPA 2019 / Consumer Protection (Consumer Commission Procedure) Regulations

entries.averment: Where filed beyond two years of the cause of action, a condonation application is attached (limitation lapse does not defeat the complaint).
